id: 15_Basic Electrical Laboratory Study of Open and Short Circuit Important Lab viva Q
title: 开路与短路实验口试问答
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/15_Basic Electrical Laboratory Study of Open and Short Circuit Important Lab viva Q.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/15_Basic Electrical Laboratory Study of Open and Short Circuit Important Lab viva Q/src.py

points.K11: 熔断器接相线、串在电路里

shots.scene: 欣欣坐在考官桌后，举起一张空白题卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot sits behind an examiner's desk holding up a blank question card, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 口试第二关：开路和短路！
overlay: 开路与短路实验口试问答

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研在实验室门口复习
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student review notes together at the lab door.
shots.narration: 阿杰和小研一起准备第二次口试。

shots.scene: 断开的电路和被导线短接的电路两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two circuit icons: one with a gap in the wire, one with a wire bridging across the lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 这次考开路、短路和相关器件。

shots.scene: 电路导线中间断开一个缺口，灯不亮
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon with a gap in the wire; the lamp is dark. No people.
shots.narration: 开路：电路某处断开了。

shots.scene: 电流箭头在缺口处停住，旁边写零
shots.prompt_en: A current arrow stops at the gap, with a zero beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 断开了，电流就是零。

shots.scene: 缺口两端电压箭头拉得很长，旁边一个无穷大符号
shots.prompt_en: Across the gap, a very long voltage arrow with an infinity symbol beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 原片说：开路时电压变为无穷大。

shots.scene: 两根导线直接碰在一起，冒出火花
shots.prompt_en: Two bare conductors touching each other directly, with a spark at the contact point. No people.
shots.narration: 短路：两根导线直接碰在一起。

shots.scene: 电流箭头变得很粗，负载两端电压为零
shots.prompt_en: A very thick current arrow bypasses the load; a zero sign beside the load. No people.
shots.narration: 短路时电压为零，电流非常大。

shots.scene: 老周比划电流冲向无穷大
shots.prompt_en: The older man spreads his arms wide beside a huge current arrow with an infinity symbol.
shots.narration: 原片说：短路电流是无穷大。

shots.scene: 雷雨中电线杆上两根导线被风吹到一起
shots.prompt_en: In a thunderstorm, two overhead wires on a utility pole swing together and spark. No people.
shots.narration: 雷雨大风时，电线相碰就会短路。

shots.scene: 欣欣对比两个图标：开路和短路相反
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the open circuit and short circuit icons side by side.
shots.narration: 开路和短路，特点正好相反。

shots.scene: 串联、并联、串并联三个电阻组合图标
shots.prompt_en: Three resistor combination icons: series, parallel, and series-parallel. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻有串联、并联、串并联三种接法。

shots.scene: 两个电阻首尾相接
shots.prompt_en: Two resistors connected end to start in a line. No people.
shots.narration: 串联：前一个的尾接后一个的头。

shots.scene: 串联电阻上同样粗的电流箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two series resistors with equal-thickness current arrows through both. No people.
shots.narration: 串联电流处处相同。

shots.scene: 两个电阻上方电压柱高低不同
shots.prompt_en: Two series resistors with voltage bars of different heights above them. No people.
shots.narration: 各个电阻的电压不同。

shots.scene: 分压公式卡片
shots.prompt_en: A blank formula card with a voltage divider icon. No people.
shots.narration: 求各段电压，用分压公式。

shots.scene: 阿杰简短作答，老周点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student answers in one short sentence; the older man nods approvingly.
shots.narration: 回答一两句话，把要点说清就行。

shots.scene: 两个电阻并排，头接头、尾接尾
shots.prompt_en: Two resistors side by side, their starting ends joined and their finishing ends joined. No people.
shots.narration: 并联：头接头，尾接尾。

shots.scene: 并联电阻上方电压柱一样高
shots.prompt_en: Two parallel resistors with voltage bars of equal height. No people.
shots.narration: 并联各支路电压相同。

shots.scene: 电流箭头在节点分成两路
shots.prompt_en: A current arrow splits into two at the junction before the parallel resistors. No people.
shots.narration: 电流分流，用分流公式求。

shots.scene: 人形图标和设备图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a person silhouette and a piece of equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 安全分人身安全和设备安全。

shots.scene: 熔断器图标，过大电流时熔丝熔断
shots.prompt_en: A fuse icon whose wire melts open when a very thick current arrow passes. No people.
shots.narration: 熔断器防过电流，保护线路和设备。

shots.section_title: 熔断器接相线、串在电路里
shots.scene: 熔断器画在相线上打勾，画在零线上打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two circuit icons: a fuse on the phase line with a green check, a fuse on the neutral line with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 熔断器要接在相线上，不接零线。
overlay: 熔断器接相线、串在电路里

shots.section_title: 熔断器接相线、串在电路里
shots.scene: 熔断器串在电路中
shots.prompt_en: A fuse connected in series in a simple circuit with a lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 熔断器和负载串联。

shots.scene: 不同大小的熔断器排成一排
shots.prompt_en: A row of fuses of different sizes. No people.
shots.narration: 熔断器规格很多，五安、三十二安、六十四安。

shots.scene: 老李对照负载的空白铭牌挑熔断器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer compares a load's blank rating plate with fuse sizes and picks one.
shots.narration: 按负载的额定电流来选。

shots.scene: 单刀单掷开关符号
shots.prompt_en: A single pole single throw switch symbol: one moving blade and one contact. No people.
shots.narration: 单刀单掷：一个刀片，一个触点。

shots.scene: 双刀单掷开关符号，两刀用虚线联动
shots.prompt_en: A double pole single throw switch symbol: two blades linked by a dashed line, two contacts. No people.
shots.narration: 双刀单掷：两个刀片一起动作。

shots.scene: 两刀分别接相线和零线
shots.prompt_en: The double pole switch symbol with one blade on the phase line and one on the neutral line. No people.
shots.narration: 一刀接相线，一刀接零线。

shots.scene: 两张题卡都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two blank question cards with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 开路短路、串并联、熔断器、开关。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻出上次的口试笔记
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes out his notes from the previous oral exam.
shots.narration: 再复习上次的题，祝考试顺利。

shots.scene: 开路、短路、串联、并联四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: open circuit, short circuit, series and parallel resistors. No people.
shots.narration: 开路电流为零，短路电流极大。

shots.scene: 熔断器和两种开关图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fuse and two switch symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 熔断器接相线，开关分单刀双刀。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研走出考场，和欣欣挥手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student walk out of the exam room and wave with the panda mascot.
shots.narration: 口试加油，下次见！
